name: Triple Tech Cost
description: Every technology level on the Tech screen costs 3 times its normal price, in tech points: Science level 2 8,000 -> 24,000, level 3 70,000 -> 210,000; Medicine level 2 5,000 -> 15,000, level 3 50,000 -> 150,000; Learning level 2 4,000 -> 12,000, level 3 35,000 -> 105,000; Construction level 2 5,000 -> 15,000, level 3 65,000 -> 195,000; Food Mastery level 2 3,000 -> 9,000, level 3 40,000 -> 120,000; Spirituality level 2 8,000 -> 24,000, level 3 80,000 -> 240,000. The Tech screen shows the tripled price, a purchase is refused (and nothing is spent) with fewer tech points than that, and buying takes exactly that many. Research, tech points from anywhere else, every other tech-point cost (such as clothes) and the patcher's own upgrades are unchanged. **Needs no other patch.** Makes the game super hard.
behavior_changes: Every non-zero entry of the technology price table 0x4CA3B4, x 3. Its only reader is the getter 0x4236D0, called by the Tech screen's hover label, information box and purchase (0x440DCA, 0x4412A0, 0x441676): the shown price, the purchase's refusal threshold and the amount it takes are the same tripled number.
explicit_non_changes: Each price is changed in place, same length; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.

Research, tech points from island events and duplicate collectibles, every other tech-point cost (such as 5,000 for clothes) and the patcher's Origins and Story / Cheat upgrades keep their stock numbers.
